import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static final int MAX = (int) 1e6 + 10;
    static final long INF = (long) 1e18;

    static long[] li() throws IOException {
        return Arrays.stream(readLine().split(" ")).mapToLong(Long::parseLong).toArray();
    }

    static int[] li2() throws IOException {
        return Arrays.stream(readLine().split(" ")).mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();
    }

    static int val() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(readLine());
    }

    static String st() throws IOException {
        return readLine();
    }

    static BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int n = val();
        int[] rock1 = li2();
        int[] rock2 = li2();

        long maximum = Math.min(rock1[0], rock2[1]) + Math.min(rock1[1], rock2[2]) + Math.min(rock1[2], rock2[0]);

        long minimum = n;
        long[][][] l1 = new long[6][3][2];
        long[][][] l2 = new long[6][3][2];

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                l1[i][j][0] = rock1[j];
                l1[i][j][1] = j + 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                l2[i][j][0] = rock2[j];
                l2[i][j][1] = j + 1;
            }
        }

        for (long[][] l : l1) {
            for (long[][] l2 : l2) {
                long ans = give(l, l2);
                minimum = Math.min(minimum, ans);
            }
        }

        writer.write(minimum + " " + maximum);
        writer.flush();
    }

    static long give(long[][] l1, long[][] l2) {
        long ans = 0;
        long[] curr1 = new long[2];
        long[] curr2 = new long[2];

        while (l1.length > 0 || l2.length > 0) {
            try {
                if (curr1[0] == 0) {
                    curr1[0] = l1[0][0];
                    curr1[1] = l1[0][1];
                    l1 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l1, 1, l1.length);
                }
                if (curr2[0] == 0) {
                    curr2[0] = l2[0][0];
                    curr2[1] = l2[0][1];
                    l2 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l2, 1, l2.length);
                }
            } catch (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
                return ans;
            }

            ans += Math.max(0, Math.min(curr1[0], curr2[0]) * match(curr1[1], curr2[1]));

            if (curr1[0] < curr2[0]) {
                curr2[0] -= curr1[0];
                curr1 = new long[2];
            } else if (curr1[0] > curr2[0]) {
                curr1[0] -= curr2[0];
                curr2 = new long[2];
            } else {
                curr1 = curr2 = new long[2];
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    static int match(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        else if ((a, b) == (1, 2) || (a, b) == (2, 3) || (a, b) == (3, 1)) return 1;
        else return -1;
    }

    static String readLine() throws IOException {
        return reader.readLine();
    }
}
